home.heroTitle: Every plant's data, in one place.
home.heroText: Aurora brings together the documents and technical information of each plant, so that partners, lawyers, lenders and distribution companies all consult the same version.

documents.title: Documents in the right place
documents.text: Each plant's contracts, minutes and powers of attorney stay together, in the version that counts.

technicalData.title: Technical data kept current
technicalData.text: Capacity, distribution company and plant status, with the date of the last update.

access.title: Access only for those who need it
access.text: Partners, lawyers and lenders sign in with their own account and see what concerns them.

home.ctaTitle: Create your account and start consulting.
home.ctaText: Use your work email. It takes less than a minute.

plantSheet.title: Plant data sheet
plantSheet.caption: Illustrative example. Your real data appears on your dashboard.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: Use the email and password of your Aurora account.

signUp.title: Create account
signUp.intro: It takes less than a minute. The password must be at least {min} characters long.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.emptyText: Your account is active. Plants and documents will appear on this dashboard as soon as they are registered.
